// Probe for tests/unit/ai-processing-consent-gate.test.ts — the source guard
// that attributes every `.extractPolicyData(` / `.askQuestion(` call to its
// enclosing named function and requires `aiProcessingConsentVersion` to be
// read EARLIER in that function. Expected offenders: ungatedScanProbe and
// lateReadProbe (a read AFTER the call is not a gate). gatedScanProbe and
// gatedArrowProbe are clean; the object-literal method mirrors the gateway.

import { db } from "@/lib/db"
import { getAIService } from "@/lib/services/ai"

// RED: sends the document with nobody's consent checked — the M2 shape.
export async function ungatedScanProbe(formData: FormData) {
    const file = formData.get("file") as File
    const bytes = Buffer.from(await file.arrayBuffer()).toString("base64")
    const aiService = getAIService()
    return aiService.extractPolicyData({ data: bytes, mimeType: "application/pdf" }, { userId: "u" })
}

// GREEN: the owner's consent is read before the provider is called. The
// return type carries a `;` inside an object type — the orchestrator's
// extractBasicSummary shape, which once ended the header walk early.
export async function gatedScanProbe(userId: string): Promise<{ status: "ok" | "blocked"; reason?: string }> {
    const owner = await db.user.findUnique({
        where: { id: userId },
        select: { aiProcessingConsentVersion: true },
    })
    if (!owner?.aiProcessingConsentVersion) return { status: "blocked", reason: "ai_consent_missing" }
    const aiService = getAIService()
    await aiService.askQuestion(null, {} as any, "q", { userId })
    return { status: "ok" }
}

// GREEN: arrow-function declaration, return type carries braces of its own.
export const gatedArrowProbe = async (userId: string): Promise<{ answer: string }> => {
    const me = await db.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId }, select: { aiProcessingConsentVersion: true } })
    if (!me?.aiProcessingConsentVersion) return { answer: "" }
    const answer = await getAIService().askQuestion(null, {} as any, "q", { userId })
    return { answer }
}

class ProbeService {
    // RED: the read comes AFTER the call — the provider already has the bytes.
    private async lateReadProbe(policyId: string): Promise<{ status: "ok" }> {
        const answer = await getAIService().askQuestion(null, {} as any, "q", { policyId })
        const owner = await db.user.findUnique({ where: { id: policyId }, select: { aiProcessingConsentVersion: true } })
        return { status: owner ? "ok" : "ok", answer } as any
    }
}

export const probeGateway = {
    // GREEN: object-literal method (the aiGateway shape), gated inline.
    async askQuestion(question: string, ctx: { userId: string; aiProcessingConsentVersion: string | null }) {
        if (!ctx.aiProcessingConsentVersion) return null
        const service = getAIService()
        return service.askQuestion(null, {} as any, question, { userId: ctx.userId })
    },
}

export { ProbeService }
